responsiveAssumptions: The deterministic desktop evidence canvas is exactly 1440x1100.
The product page keeps all nine operational columns available through horizontal table overflow on narrower viewports.
The navigation and filter controls collapse only outside the fixed desktop evidence viewport.

componentMappings.region: product shell, rail, header, and content frame

referenceContractConflicts.detail: The generated rail measures about 230px while the frozen layout.nav.width token is 240px.
referenceContractConflicts.resolution: The implementation keeps the frozen 240px rail and records the resulting shell displacement in raw diff evidence.

referenceContractConflicts.detail: The generated product header measures about 79px while the frozen product header contract is 64px.
referenceContractConflicts.resolution: The implementation keeps the frozen 64px header and treats the vertical displacement as a known semantic reconstruction residual.

referenceContractConflicts.detail: The generated filter controls and table rows are taller than the compact frozen control tokens.
referenceContractConflicts.resolution: The implementation uses the current kit components and adjusts page-level density without changing shared token or bundle gates.

referenceContractConflicts.detail: Generated Chinese glyphs and small navigation icons contain raster variation.
referenceContractConflicts.resolution: All interface text and icons are reconstructed as accessible code using the frozen component and token system.

interactionStates: New Firmware Version opens a controlled Drawer and restores the base state after cancel.
Rollback and stop actions open a ConfirmDialog that names the target version and restores focus to the exact row action that opened it.
The screenshot baseline keeps every overlay closed.
Visible focus and reduced-motion behavior remain available.
